definitions.short: a brocade ; by analogy, a (reticulated) setting of a gem
definitions.full: H4865. mishbetsah מִשְׁבְּצ(וֺ)ת noun feminine Exod 28:25 plural chequered (or plaited ) work, usually of settings for gems; — ׳מ צָהָב (i.e. plaited with gold-thread) for two gems on high priest's ephod (P): Exod 28:11 , 13 ; 39:6 , 13 , 16 ; ׳מ absolute 28:14 , 25 , 39 ; 39:18 ; ׳מִמּ ׳ז לְבוּשָׁהּ Psa 45:14 her clothing is of chequer work in wrought with gold; < Krochm Gr Che comm. {abbrev } לְבוּשָׁהּ ז בְּמִשְׁבְּצוֺת מְּנִינִים (see מְּנִימָה above) pearls in plaited settings of gold (-thread).
